items.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has directed Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy to refund ₹546.18 crore to investors. Avadhut Sathe and his academy provided unregistered investment advisory services under the pretext of education. The regulator found that misleading testimonials were circulated while concealing overall trading losses. A penalty of ₹11.5 crore was imposed on Sathe and the academy for their actions.

items.title: Casio G-Shock GMC-2500 price, features and India availability: 5 new watches unveiled
items.summary: Casio has unveiled five new G-Shock GMC-2500 watches featuring metal and resin straps, a magnetic shock-resistant minute hand and 200-metre water resistance. The watches offer a two-year battery life, an analogue display and a stopwatch, with Japanese prices ranging from 37,400 yen to 49,500 yen.

items.summary: Goldman Sachs downgraded Ola Electric to Sell and cut its price target to ₹23 from ₹39.28, citing weak cash flow, funding needs, high interest costs and operational challenges. It expects prolonged losses and tougher competition to hinder the company’s recovery.

items.title: Anthropic IPO: What should investors consider when valuing the AI company? Aswath Damodaran explains
items.summary: Anthropic is on track for an IPO expected in mid-November, reporting impressive revenues of $16.3 billion. However, the company faces a staggering net loss of over $80 billion for the year. Valuation expert Aswath Damodaran warns that IPO investor metrics can be erratic and heavily influenced by market sentiment. As Anthropic navigates an evolving business model, investors are advised to look beyond venture capital evaluations for a clearer understanding.

items.summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices will soon change its rules for classifying growth and value shares. The new criteria will incorporate intangible assets, forward earnings, and free cash flow instead of relying on 12-month price momentum. These changes are expected to affect approximately $375 billion of passive funds linked to the index. FTSE Russell is also considering adjustments due to the dominance of technology companies.

Consolidated revenue from operations increased by 29.7% compared to the previous fiscal year. As of September 30, 2026, BPCL's cumulative under recoveries on LPG reached ₹17,334.40 crore.

items.title: Adani Power profit surges 142% on strong demand amid weak rains
items.summary: Adani Power has reported a 142% increase in net profit for the July-September quarter. This profit was driven by strong electricity demand and exceptional prior-period income. Operating revenue for the company saw a nearly 30% increase compared to the previous year. The company also recognized significant revenue due to adjustments in historic energy charges under its power purchase agreements.

items.title: JSW Steel posts three-fold jump in profit, lines up capacity expansion
items.summary: JSW Steel achieved an impressive three-fold rise in its consolidated net profit for the September quarter, highlighted by a record-breaking 13% increase in sales volumes compared to last year. The company has received approval for ambitious expansion projects, aiming to add 5 million tonnes at the Utkal site in Odisha.

items.title: 5 world market themes for the week ahead
items.summary: An important week is upcoming with central banks like the Federal Reserve and European Central Bank making policy decisions. Major companies, including Alphabet, Amazon, and Microsoft, are set to report their earnings. Political events are also significant, with elections in Israel and Brazil influencing markets. China's leadership will hold discussions focused on party governance amidst external pressures.

items.title: US consumer sentiment near record low ahead of midterm elections
items.summary: In October, consumer sentiment in the U.S. plummeted to a concerning 48.0, driven by rising prices and economic worries amid the ongoing Middle East conflict. Survey results suggest that independents show the steepest drop in confidence, approaching historical lows. Additionally, inflation expectations have risen, marking a continuation of trends from earlier this year. Federal Reserve officials are attentively observing these shifts as they plan future interest rate adjustments.

items.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Earnings flood, Fed meeting will test rickety AI market rally
items.summary: US stock investors are on the edge of their seats as they anticipate quarterly earnings from tech giants like Alphabet, Microsoft, and Amazon. This week is pivotal, with the Federal Reserve meeting also in sight, likely to shape how investors feel about the AI sector. After disappointing earnings from firms such as Meta and Lam Research, mixed sentiment looms over the market, especially with the midterm elections on the horizon.

items.title: Indians remit $2.7 billion overseas in August, led by travel
items.summary: Outward remittances under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) stood at $2.7 billion, with travel accounting for the largest chunk. Indians spent $1.6 billion on travel in August, from $1.7 billion in July, while $275 million were spent on maintenan-ce of relatives. Indian citizen spent $321 million on investments in equity and debt, while $191 million on studies abroad.

items.title: Gross FDI inflows to India fall to $11 billion in August
items.summary: Gross foreign direct investment (FDI) to India decreased to $11 billion in August, from $14 billion a month ago. Net FDI to India slows $3 billion in August, from $7 billion in July. Financial services, communication services, computer services and manufacturing accounted for around 73% of total FDI equity inflows during April-August 2026.

items.title: Swiggy sinks 16% to record low as quick-commerce losses widen
items.summary: Shares of Swiggy fell by 16.4% to ₹176.70, marking a record low for the company. This decline raises concerns over cash burn and achieving profitability in its quick-commerce business. Analysts are questioning Swiggy's strategic choices and execution following its market debut. The widening losses in the quick-commerce segment have drawn attention to the company's overall performance.

items.title: US Midterms Deep Dive: Where is Elon Musk spending $366 mn? What could a Republican win mean for SpaceX, Tesla?

items.title: BSE begins hunt for MD & CEO successor ahead of 2027 exit
items.summary: BSE has initiated the search for its next managing director and chief executive officer. Sundararaman Ramamurthy is scheduled to retire in June 2027 after reaching the age limit. The exchange is looking for candidates with at least 20 years of experience, which includes senior leadership roles. Applicants need to be under 62 years old as of July 1, 2027.

items.title: IndusInd Bank posts Rs 1,242 crore net profit on lower provisions
items.summary: IndusInd Bank reported an impressive consolidated net profit of ₹1,242 crore for the September quarter, marking a robust recovery from the previous year's loss of ₹437 crore. This turnaround stems from decreased provisions and heightened fee income, alongside encouraging trends in asset quality, evidenced by reduced non-performing asset ratios. The bank's financial outlook showcases a significant improvement in both growth and profitability.

items.title: India is not living in isolation, says Piyush Goyal, as India-EU FTA and several trade pacts pave the way for German R&D
items.summary: Piyush Goyal emphasized the importance of collaboration between Indian and German research institutes during his visit. He highlighted the potential for co-development and co-innovation under the India-EU free trade agreement. Goyal encouraged the institutes to connect research with industry in order to support manufacturing in India. The minister also mentioned India's extensive trade agreements that will boost global market access.

items.title: Volvo layoff: Carmaker to cut 2,500 jobs globally as Q3 loss widens, to affect about 6% of workforce
items.summary: Volvo Cars announced it would cut about 2,500 jobs worldwide, 2,000 of which are in Sweden, saying it was facing “a very tough environment”, including US tariffs and “hypercompetition” from local brands in China.

items.title: Infosys upbeat on deals, cautious on growth as competition intensifies
items.summary: Infosys released its quarterly results, showing good revenue growth and stable operating margins. However, the management reduced the annual revenue guidance due to competitive pressures. The company secured a significant $2 billion deal, boosting its total contract value to $5.2 billion. Despite positive performance from some sectors, weaknesses in others contributed to the cautious outlook. The market response led to a rise in the stock price, affecting valuation metrics.

items.title: SpaceX’s $40 billion AI debt plan faces market turmoil. Can investors stomach the growing borrowing risks?
items.summary: SpaceX’s efforts to finalize a $40 billion off-balance-sheet debt structure for its artificial intelligence buildout have been roiled by recent market turmoil that’s driven up sector-wide borrowing costs and complicated price talks.

The subscription soared to 22.19 times, mainly due to robust involvement from institutional investors, including domestic mutual funds and foreign entities. This enthusiasm contrasts with current trends in the secondary market, and shares are scheduled for listing on October 28, showcasing Jio's strides in the digital and telecommunications arenas.

items.title: Akasa Air extends suspension of flights to Jeddah, Riyadh amid evolving security situation in Saudi Arabia
items.summary: Akasa Air has announced the extension of its flight suspensions to Jeddah and Riyadh due to rising security concerns. The airline's decision is based on a careful assessment of the prevailing safety environment in Saudi Arabia. Passengers whose flights are affected can choose full refunds or reschedule their trips without extra charges. The Indian government is actively assisting stranded Umrah pilgrims and coordinating their return home.

items.title: Small and midcap indices post worst weekly decline in two years
items.summary: Mid-cap and small-cap stocks in India have faced major declines, indicating a shift in market sentiment. The Nifty MidCap 150 and Small-cap 250 indices reported their worst weekly falls in two years. Domestic retail investors initially supported these segments by increasing mutual fund contributions. However, concerns over rising oil prices and fiscal deficits are adding to market uncertainties.

items.title: Volkswagen freezes India EV investment as JSW partnership talks continue
items.summary: Volkswagen has paused further investment in its India electric-vehicle programme pending greater clarity on a potential partnership with Sajjan Jindal’s JSW Group. The German automaker has completed preliminary design work using a low-cost EV platform developed for China but awaits a clearer business plan. The pause could delay its India EV push as competition intensifies and affordable electric-car sales accelerate.

items.title: RBI’s forward dollar sales surge to record $200 billion in August
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India recorded a net purchase of $43.26 billion in August's foreign exchange market. This was done to manage significant dollar inflows from the FCNR(B) scheme and overseas borrowings. Despite the net purchase, foreign exchange reserves did not increase due to large forex sell/buy swaps. By August 31, measures attracted over $127 billion, aiding the RBI's operations.
